description: Ports eslint-plugin-vue 10.11.1 `vue/no-mutating-props` with default options (shallowOnly: false): a mutation of a component prop, reported at the mutating node (assignment, update, delete, call of push/pop/shift/unshift/reverse/splice/sort/copyWithin/fill, or Object.assign with the prop as first argument). Reads the view program: (1) template code inside the `<template` statement block: an identifier not bound by a v-for/slot arrow whose name is a prop (Options API `props` array strings and object keys of `export default {}`/`defineComponent({})`/`Vue.component/mixin/extend`/`new Vue({})`, `<script setup>` `defineProps` runtime array/object keys, `defineProps<{...}>()` type-literal and same-file interface/type-alias members that are neither a JS global from the upstream whitelist nor a binding of the script, plus the names destructured from `defineProps`) or the `defineProps` result variable, and `this.<prop>`; `v-model` and `.sync` expressions are reported as a whole when their member chain starts at such a name; (2) script code: `this.<prop>` (or a `const vm = this` alias) inside a Vue object that declares the prop; (3) references (outside the template) to the `setup(props)` first parameter, to the `const props = defineProps()` / `withDefaults(defineProps())` variable (a mutation needs at least one member access, as upstream), and to names destructured from either (a member mutation, or a mutating call on the bare name).
